title: Promise instance .catch() is a compile error in authored .vibe
notes: docs/src/pages/specification/failures.mdx 'Promise Semantics' and docs/DECISIONS.md 'Concurrency' require Promise instance .catch() to be rejected by the Promise-discipline rule, not by the retired postfix-catch migration rule. VIBE1402 matches the two sibling .then() and .finally() cases: rejecting the chaining spelling leaves the started Promise unconsumed.
